title: SuperDash 1.6 — Mobile Minimalism, Premium Icons & Quick Controls
summary: Refined mobile home screen with Liquid Glass Quick Controls bottom sheet, pristine 4-column app launcher, brand-new OS-grade squircle icons, zero-clutter layout, and real in-app APK streaming downloads.
highlights: Native Liquid Glass Quick Controls Bottom Sheet from mobile header
Clean Minimalist Home: removed markets strip and cluttered category rail
Original SuperDash OS-grade squircle icons with directional lighting and specular bevels
Evenly spaced 4-column responsive app launcher grid
In-App update download engine with live byte progress tracking and APK install intent

changes.description: Simplified Home composition: compact header, universal search, clean APPLICATIONS heading, and 4-column grid. Markets and categories removed.
Header sliders button now opens a native Liquid Glass Bottom Sheet without shifting or expanding the header, with theme, edit mode, alerts, and settings.
Bespoke squircle icons for all 15 core apps with 22% curvature, inner specular glow, drop shadow, and clean typography.
Unified Time app with Liquid Glass hourglass timer, Pomodoro focus goals, and global world clock timezones.
Merged standard math and multi-currency exchange converter into a single streamlined utility.
Integrated timed alarms, reminders, and daily checklists in one clean view.
Live byte-level download progress bar and direct APK package installation from Settings.
